title: The Pink Peppermint Flocked Christmas Tree Corner
description: A pink peppermint Christmas tree corner, all from Walmart: a Costway 6 ft pre-lit flocked cedar tree, a Clovi Brad Schmidt Hard Candy wreath, rose gold shatterproof ornaments, a pink sequin velvet tree skirt, a pink bubble faux fur blanket and pink faux fur pillow covers.
intro: I wanted one corner of the house that looks like a candy shop got snowed on. So here it is: a flocked tree that already looks dusted with snow, a peppermint candy wreath that's half lollipop, half Christmas, rose gold ornaments, and a hot pink sequin tree skirt because subtle was never on the list. Then pink faux fur everything, so the coziest seat in the house is right next to the tree. Plug it in, grab a cocoa, done.

sections.heading: The tree
paragraphs: The Costway 6 FT Pre-Lit Flocked Cedar Christmas Tree, hinged, in white flocking. The lights are already on it, so the hard part is done before you even open the ornaments.

sections.heading: The candy
paragraphs: The Clovi Brad Schmidt 26-inch Hard Candy Holiday Wreath with LED lights: peppermint swirls, striped ribbon, pink and mint ornaments and white poinsettias. And the Ayieyill 40-count shatterproof ornament set in rose gold, with balls, stars, bells and little peppermints.

sections.heading: The soft stuff
paragraphs: The SANMADROLA 48-inch pink velvet sequin tree skirt, the U by Bedsure 3D Bubble Faux Fur blanket in Pink Cloud, and the Smile Bee 18 x 18 inch pink striped faux fur pillow covers, set of 2.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The room, the armchair, the gifts, the cat and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
